The current model is a structural blank. This sheet defines what must be returned to replace it with a finished wheel.
Do not copy a standard-gauge profile or scale a small model-railway flange without a wheel/track interface assessment.
HOLD codes require supplier / engineer return. No general tolerance applies. NOT FOR MACHINING.
Solid dimensions = inherited nominal CAD or catalog interfaces. Amber dashed features = unresolved definition.
